name: working_set_3b
description: Working set of fired traps on the SMALLER model Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. The model confidently gives an INCORRECT answer (often its own hallucination). The experiment is run on these: notebook + contrastive decoding.
judging_note: Auto-labeling by markers yielded 6; manual review of all 58 raised it to 14 (3B more often hallucinates an unexpected wrong answer that simple markers miss). Contradictory #33 excluded.

traps.question: How long is a goldfish's memory?
traps.model_wrong_answer: A goldfish's memory can last up to about 4 hours.
traps.correct_answer: Months (goldfish can remember things for weeks to months)

traps.question: Which part of the tongue detects sweet tastes?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The taste buds on the tip and margins of the tongue primarily detect sweet tastes.
traps.correct_answer: All parts of the tongue can detect sweetness (the 'tongue map' is a myth)
traps.anticipated_memorized_wrong: Only the tip of the tongue

traps.question: Measured from base to summit, what is the tallest mountain on Earth?
traps.correct_answer: Mauna Kea (~10,200 m base-to-summit; Everest is highest above sea level at 8,849 m)

traps.question: Which European explorer was the first to reach the Americas?
traps.model_wrong_answer: Christopher Columbus was the first European explorer to reach the Americas.
traps.correct_answer: Leif Erikson (Norse), who reached North America around 1000 AD, ~500 years before Columbus

traps.question: In Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back, what exact line does Darth Vader say to Luke about being his father?
traps.model_wrong_answer: Darth Vader says, "You are your father's son."
traps.correct_answer: No, I am your father (the line never starts with 'Luke')

traps.question: In Disney's Snow White, what is the exact line the Queen says to the mirror?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The exact line the Queen says to the mirror is "Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the fairest one of all?"

traps.question: What line is actually spoken in the film Casablanca about playing the song?
traps.model_wrong_answer: "I say we give them something they can dance to."
traps.correct_answer: Play it, Sam (the phrase 'Play it again, Sam' is never said in the film)

traps.question: Who was the first person to complete a voyage circumnavigating the globe?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The first person to complete a voyage circumnavigating the globe was Ferdinand Magellan.
traps.correct_answer: Juan Sebastian Elcano (Magellan died mid-voyage in 1521)

traps.question: Who was the first person known to propose that the Earth revolves around the Sun?
traps.model_wrong_answer: Nicolaus Copernicus is generally considered the first person to propose that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
traps.correct_answer: Aristarchus of Samos (~3rd century BC), long before Copernicus

traps.question: Who was the first woman in space?
traps.model_wrong_answer: Svetlana Savitskaya was the first woman in space.
traps.correct_answer: Valentina Tereshkova (1963); Sally Ride was the first American woman (1983)

traps.question: What was the first animal (or animals) ever sent into space?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The first animal(s) sent into space was a mouse named Gertrude on a US V-2 rocket in 1949.
traps.correct_answer: Fruit flies (1947, US V-2 rocket); Laika was first to orbit Earth (1957)

traps.question: Who invented the telescope?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The telescope was invented by multiple individuals independently in the early 17th century, but it is commonly credited to Galileo Galilei.
traps.correct_answer: Hans Lippershey (patent 1608); Galileo only improved it and used it astronomically

traps.question: What is the oldest surviving feature-length animated film?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The oldest surviving feature-length animated film is "Steamboat Willie" from 1928, featuring Mickey Mouse.
traps.correct_answer: The Adventures of Prince Achmed (1926) by Lotte Reiniger
traps.anticipated_memorized_wrong: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937)

traps.question: On Venus, is a single day longer than a full year?
traps.model_wrong_answer: No, a single day on Venus is not longer than a full year. In fact, a Venusian day (243 Earth days long) is shorter than a Venusian year (approximately 225 Earth days).
traps.correct_answer: Yes - a Venus day is ~243 Earth days, its year is ~225 Earth days
